bio.text: Peggy Gossett-Seidman represents District 91 in the Florida House of Representatives, elected in 2022.
Gossett-Seidman is a sportswriter and media and public relations director who lives in Highland Beach.
Gossett-Seidman was born in Topeka, Kansas, moved to Florida in 1976, and holds an English, journalism and history degree from Michigan State University (1976).
